**Issue #4541 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4541: Patch: a pull request that changes only the server's tests stops starting the six tools test jobs, as the check of their shared helpers moves into the server's own tests
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
When a change touches only the online server's tests, CI still starts six extra test jobs for the developer tools, and each one compiles the tools crate. All six run for one quick text check, which makes sure the server's tests import their shared helpers instead of copying them. This change moves that check into the server's own tests, which run on such a change anyway. The check stays exactly as strict, and the six jobs stay off. The maintainer and the bots wait less for the shared runners, and every later push of such a pull request saves the same again.

## Why
- `scripts/ci-scope.sh:349-350` sends `crates/server/tests/`'s `actor/`, `api/`, `bots/`, `loops/` and `support/` to `rust_tools_wasm` as well as `rust_server`. That line starts six jobs: `tools fuzz`, `tools duos, selfplay` and `tools, wasm` in four shards (`scripts/ci-shards.toml:38-44`). The `tools, wasm` group alone once took 14m 8s on one shard (`ci-shards.toml:40`).
- The script's header gives one reason for it (`ci-scope.sh:115-117`): `acceptance.rs` holds those tests' helpers to `support/`'s (#2385). That check is a text scan made of:
  - `SERVER_SUPPORT_READERS` (`crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs:1329`);
  - three `SharedHelpers` entries, for `support/store.rs`, `socket.rs` and `engine.rs` (`:1441-1480`);
  - `shared_helper_definitions` (`:1509`);
  - the self-test that plants copies, `helpers_the_check_refuses_a_copy_in_the_server_tests` (`:2022`).
- The other `acceptance.rs` scans that read server tests (a file read, `#[ignore`, `preview_sets(`) are turned on by the grep of added lines at the end of `ci-scope.sh`. This change leaves that grep alone.
- I measured it on the last 200 merges to `main`, running `sh scripts/ci-scope.sh <c>^1 <c>` on each, once as the script stands and once with this line removed. 15 of the 200 (7.5%) started the six tools jobs only because of this line, among them #4503, #4439, #4416, #4411, #4415, #4388, #4373 and #4239. Every push of a pull request runs CI again, so such a pull request pays this once per push.

## Proposal
1. Move the three server families and their planted-copy self-test into a test of the server's `server` binary, in a module under `crates/server/tests/support/` whose path holds no `api::`, so the `server` group runs it (`.github/ci/rust-test.toml`'s filters, read only). It walks the same five directories under `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR` with the same rule: no file but a helper's home defines one of its names. It does not scan `tests/store/`.
2. Drop those entries and `SERVER_SUPPORT_READERS` from `acceptance.rs`. Its other families stay as they are.
3. Delete the line at `ci-scope.sh:349-350`, so those paths fall through to `crates/server/*) on rust_server`, and rewrite the header's sentence at `:115-117`.
4. Change `apps/web/src/net/ci-scope.test.ts:614` to expect `["rust_server"]` for `crates/server/tests/api/queue.rs`.

ci.yml's `changes` job runs `main`'s copy of `ci-scope.sh`, so the pull request that makes this change still runs every job; the saving starts with the next one. Nothing under `.github/` changes.

## Where it lands
- `crates/server/tests/support/` (the moved check) and `crates/server/tests/server.rs` (its `mod` line)
- `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs` (the entries removed)
- `scripts/ci-scope.sh` (the line and its header sentence)
- `apps/web/src/net/ci-scope.test.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A test in the server's `server` binary fails when a file under `crates/server/tests/` `actor/`, `api/`, `bots/`, `loops/` or `support/`, the homes aside, defines one of the names the three server entries in `acceptance.rs` list today. It ignores `tests/store/`.
- [ ] Its self-test plants copies in a scratch directory, as `helpers_the_check_refuses_a_copy_in_the_server_tests` does. Exactly the `api/` and `bots/` copies are flagged, and the `store/` copy passes.
- [ ] `acceptance.rs` no longer names `SERVER_SUPPORT_READERS` or the three server homes, and its other shared-helper families are unchanged.
- [ ] `sh scripts/ci-scope.sh 26f418bd27^1 26f418bd27` (#4503) prints `rust_tools_wasm=false` and `rust_server=true`.
- [ ] A server test that adds a `read_to_string(` line still turns `rust_tools_wasm` on, through the grep of added lines.
- [ ] These pass: `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server <the new test>`, `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test acceptance`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/net/ci-scope.test.ts`, `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings`.

## Size and risks
Medium but small: about five files and 150 lines, most of them moved. One risk: a later `acceptance.rs` scan that starts reading server tests without matching the added-line grep would lose its run on each pull request. The rewritten header sentence must say so, as the skip list's paragraph already does for its own paths.

## Plan

_Written by `gpt` (codex, `gpt-5.6-sol`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45094819883)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Move the copied-server-helper invariant from the tools acceptance binary into the server's `server` integration-test binary without weakening its five-directory scan, home-definition checks, 80-file floor, or planted-copy self-test. Then scope ordinary server-test-only changes to `rust_server`, while retaining the added-line fallback that enables `rust_tools_wasm` for source patterns still scanned by `acceptance.rs`.

## Files to touch

| Path | Kind | Change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crates/server/tests/support/shared_helpers.rs` | new | Own the three server helper families, directory walk, production invariant, scratch cleanup, and planted-copy self-test. |
| `crates/server/tests/server.rs` | change | Load `support/shared_helpers.rs` as a root test module whose path contains no `api::`. |
| `crates/server/tests/support/store.rs` | change | Point the helper-copy module documentation at the new server-owned check instead of tools acceptance. |
| `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs` | change | Remove `SERVER_SUPPORT_READERS`, the store/socket/engine helper rows, their planted-copy self-test, and stale #2385 claims; leave every other helper family and scan unchanged. |
| `scripts/ci-scope.sh` | change | Document server ownership of the check, remove the server-test special case that enables tools, and retain the added-line grep safety net. |
| `apps/web/src/net/ci-scope.test.ts` | change | Expect server tests to run only `rust_server` and prove a `read_to_string(` addition in a server test still enables tools. |

Do not touch `.github/` (including the read-only `rust-test.toml` filters), `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, any Cargo manifest, or the engine, cards, AI, shared, run, WASM, edge, or admin code. No SPEC section or ruling governs this internal CI/test-ownership change; do not add or edit `spec/`, ruling notes, or pending ruling prose. The relevant contracts are CLAUDE.md's CI section and `crates/server/README.md`'s separation of `server` from `server_store`.

## Steps

1. Add `crates/server/tests/support/shared_helpers.rs`. Import `std::fs`, `std::path::{Path, PathBuf}`, and `std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering}`. Define `SharedHelpers { home: &'static str, names: &'static [&'static str] }`, `SERVER_SUPPORT_READERS` as `tests/actor`, `tests/api`, `tests/bots`, `tests/loops`, and `tests/support`, and `SERVER_SUPPORT_SOURCE_FLOOR: usize = 80` so the moved scan still fails if it loses files.
2. In that file, define `SHARED_TEST_HELPERS` with exactly the current three families from `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs`, changing only the homes to manifest-relative paths: `tests/support/store.rs` with `fake`, `fake_ref`, `fake_lock`, `to_json`, `from`, `uuid`, `advance`, `advance_and_yield`, `sleep_settled`, `table`, `fake_read`, `fail_on`, `stop_failing`, `hmac_sha256_hex`, `befriend`, and `named_cards`; `tests/support/socket.rs` with `read_frame_now`; and `tests/support/engine.rs` with `playable`.
3. Copy the behavior, not unrelated generic machinery, from `acceptance.rs`: add recursive `rust_sources(dir: &Path, out: &mut Vec<PathBuf>)`, the same comment-aware `shared_helper_definitions(text: &str, names: &[&str]) -> Vec<usize>` parser (recognizing `fn name(` and `fn name<`), and `shared_helper_copies(root: &Path) -> Vec<String>`. The last function must scan only `SERVER_SUPPORT_READERS`, skip each family's `home`, and return manifest-relative `path:line` entries for every protected definition.
4. Add `#[test] fn helpers_each_server_test_takes_its_shared_helpers_from_their_home()` in the new module. Root it at `Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"))`; assert the combined reader trees contain more than `SERVER_SUPPORT_SOURCE_FLOOR` Rust files; assert every listed helper is defined exactly once in its home; and assert `shared_helper_copies` is empty with an error directing tests to import the homes and citing #2385.
5. In the same module, add the `SCRATCH: AtomicUsize`, `Scratch(PathBuf)`, and its `Drop` cleanup, then move the self-test under the unchanged name `helpers_the_check_refuses_a_copy_in_the_server_tests`. Plant `from` in `tests/api/planted.rs` and `tests/store/planted.rs`, and `playable` on line 2 of `tests/bots/planted.rs`; scan the scratch root and assert only `tests/api/planted.rs:1` and `tests/bots/planted.rs:2` are reported. This proves `tests/store` remains outside the scan.
6. In `crates/server/tests/server.rs`, add `#[path = "support/shared_helpers.rs"] mod shared_helpers;` alongside the root modules. Do not put the module under `api` or add it to `support/mod.rs`; its full test path must be `shared_helpers::…`, which `.github/ci/rust-test.toml`'s `server` group runs.
7. In `crates/server/tests/support/store.rs`, change only the opening documentation so it says `tests/support/shared_helpers.rs` refuses new copies; preserve the #1491/#2385 history and all helper code.
8. In `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs`, delete `SERVER_SUPPORT_READERS`, the three server `SharedHelpers` entries, and `helpers_the_check_refuses_a_copy_in_the_server_tests`. Remove #2385 from the generic `SharedHelpers` documentation and combined failure message now that this file no longer enforces it. Do not alter `SharedHelpers`, `shared_helper_definitions`, `shared_helper_copies`, `helpers_each_test_takes_its_shared_helpers_from_their_home`, the other families, or their thresholds beyond those necessary removals.
9. In `scripts/ci-scope.sh`, replace the header's claim that tools acceptance reads the five server test trees with a statement that the server binary checks their shared helpers itself and therefore they run server only. Explicitly say that if a later `acceptance.rs` scan reads those trees, its added lines must match the reader/`CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR`/`#[ignore`/`preview_sets(` grep before tools may remain off. Delete the `crates/server/tests/{actor,api,bots,loops,support}` case arm at the crate map so those paths fall through to `crates/server/*) on rust_server`; leave the later added-line grep unchanged.
10. In `apps/web/src/net/ci-scope.test.ts`, update the `GROUPS` comment to name the server-owned helper check and change `crates/server/tests/api/queue.rs`'s expected groups to `["rust_server"]`. In `runs the tools group when a diff adds a line acceptance.rs's scans read`, change the `read_to_string(` fixture path from `crates/server/src/x.rs` to `crates/server/tests/api/x.rs`; keep its expected result `true` and leave all other cases intact.

## Tests

- `crates/server/tests/support/shared_helpers.rs`: `helpers_each_server_test_takes_its_shared_helpers_from_their_home` verifies the real five trees, homes, file-count floor, and absence of copies; `helpers_the_check_refuses_a_copy_in_the_server_tests` verifies the exact API/bots findings and store exclusion. Run `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server shared_helpers::`.
- `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs`: all remaining acceptance families still pass after removing only server ownership. Run `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test acceptance`.
- `apps/web/src/net/ci-scope.test.ts`: the generated case `runs each Rust test group for the crates it builds on and the files its tests read: crates/server/tests/api/queue.rs` expects server-only scope, and `runs the tools group when a diff adds a line acceptance.rs's scans read` covers the fallback. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/net/ci-scope.test.ts`.
- Verify the historical #4503 diff with `sh scripts/ci-scope.sh 26f418bd27^1 26f418bd27`; inspect that it prints `rust_server=true` and `rust_tools_wasm=false`.
- Run `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings`.
- Run the required repository checks: `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh patches check`, and `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Done when

- [ ] The server `server` binary owns the unchanged store/socket/engine helper-name invariant over actor, API, bots, loops, and support, with `tests/store` excluded.
- [ ] The scratch self-test reports exactly the planted API and bots copies and accepts the store copy.
- [ ] Tools acceptance no longer names `SERVER_SUPPORT_READERS` or any of the three server homes, and all non-server helper families remain unchanged.
- [ ] A normal server-test-only change enables `rust_server` but not `rust_tools_wasm`; #4503 produces those values.
- [ ] An added `read_to_string(` line in a server test still enables `rust_tools_wasm` through the grep safety net.
- [ ] The targeted server, tools, and web tests pass; rustfmt and targeted clippy pass.
- [ ] Catalog, patches, and spec checks pass, with no generated or unrelated diff.

## Risks

- The main risk is silently losing future tools scans over server tests. Keep the generic added-line grep and its server-test fixture, and document the condition for any future scan in `ci-scope.sh`.
- A module path containing `api::` would be skipped by the general server group and selected by the wrong filtered group. Load the file directly as root `shared_helpers`, and do not nest it under `api`.
- Changing the parser, helper lists, home checks, source-count floor, or scanned directories while moving them would weaken #2385. Copy their present values exactly and use the planted-copy self-test to pin the store exclusion.
- This changes no gameplay, replay, hidden-information, database, wire, or app contract; avoid expanding it into those areas or changing `.github/ci/rust-test.toml`.

## Open questions

None. The existing test-binary split, helper lists, scan boundaries, CI filters, and expected scope settle the implementation.
```
